title: FLF Mountable Dual Hose Separator (3D-Printed / With Mounting Tab)
description: FLF’s Mountable Dual Hose Separator addresses what our Billet Dual Hose Separators have been lacking for a long time – a mounting tab! These CAD-designed pieces are 3D-printed from an extremely durable and temperature-resistant polymer with brass thread inserts for long service life.
